scientific_role: New adaptive calibration candidate screen only AFTER complete original frozen0/1/2 comparison is audited and reported. This cannot retroactively make the failed original frozen model stable.
hypothesis: A fixed, uniform whole-bag mixture of all three trained seed ensembles may reduce shared cell-distribution bias through forecast diversity without changing counts or using real resampling. Include every seed equally; no seed, mask or weight ranking.

outer_mask.rule: 66of200 bags from each model plus two extra bags; exclude model index (4*replica+stage)%3 from the extras, giving each stage exactly200. Independent fixed random permutation seed20261110+100*replica+stage. Never scan masks.

screen_inputs: Existing saved generated summaries/cell reservoirs and their audited metrics/checkpoint/array proofs. No newly loaded target arrays, evaluation donors, fitting or generation. Compare one fixed mask expectation/weighted empirical mixture against current pure incumbent jointly.
screen_rule: Strictly lower expected donor ES AND no greater empirical pooled cell ED than current selected pure incumbent. A screen is not a native result; native common-query/RNG/count/spread/exactsource/generation proof and fresh independent confirmation are still mandatory before claiming ATH or stable performance.
calibration_limit: Using model outcomes from seeds0/1/2 for this next adaptive candidate makes them selection evidence. They cannot also serve as independent confirmation of this new ensemble.
training_compute: Uses six full parent models:120000 aggregate parent updates, compared with40000 for original two-parent seed0 ensemble. Disclose extra compute.
